summary: Temporary cabinet key, visitor badge, and cross-border monitor shipment for hybrid contractor (LON)
description:
Issue summary: New hybrid contractor (Jordan Blake) starts 2026-03-04 and requires (1) temporary visitor badge for 3rd-floor access with locker/cabinet key for shared storage, (2) two monitors + dock shipped from US office to London with customs paperwork prepared, and (3) an onsite desk kitting window during a scheduled building maintenance on 2026-03-03. Impact: If not completed before start date, contractor cannot access equipment or workspace and onboarding will be delayed. Environment: London office (3rd floor, zone C).

Requested items and constraints:
- Temporary badge active 2026-03-04 to 2026-04-04, expiry auto-revoked if not extended. Badge must include temporary RBAC mapping: group "contractors-lon-3c" with elevator/stairs access and entry window 07:30-19:30.
- Physical cabinet key (small metal locker 3C-07) to be provisioned; security requires key sign-out and photo ID record.
- Ship 2x 27" monitors (serials to be recorded), 1x USB-C dock from Redwood SF asset pool. Ship via vendor courier (DDP preferred). Commercial invoice and CN23 must list Redwood as importer, include HS codes, and mention "business equipment - no commercial resale".
- Kitting/setup: IT to pre-tag assets with asset IDs, map to Jordan's OKTA account, and provision temporary machine profile. A desk placement in zone C, cubicle #C7 has been requested. Building maintenance narrow window 2026-03-03 09:00-12:00 (lifts access limited).

Steps taken so far:
- Reporter opened ticket and confirmed hire details with People Ops.
- Shipping request placed with SF asset pool on 2026-02-26; awaiting customs paperwork and pickup slot.
- Facilities reserved cabinet 3C-07 and requested a physical key from building security.
- Security flagged that temporary badge provisioning requires PII photo and signed contractor agreement uploaded to tracker.

Expected outcome: Badge active and key issued by 2026-03-03 EOD; monitors and dock delivered and tagged by 2026-03-04 09:00; desk kitting completed before contractor arrival.

Actual status: Partial. Badge template created but awaiting HR photo and signed agreement. Shipping hold due to missing commercial invoice details and missing declared value per courier. Facilities holds key and will cut on receipt of approval code from Security.

Attachments and refs: building badge template link: https://confluence.redwood/workspaces/facilities/lon/badges; vendor tracker: GH-asset-shipping-497; courier quote: DHL-3071.
steps_to_reproduce:
1. Attempt badge activation without photo/contractor agreement -> activation blocked by security workflow.
2. Attempt to book international shipment without commercial invoice -> courier rejects pickup.
3. Attempt to cut key without security approval code -> security logs audit will block handover.
investigation_notes:
- 2026-02-26: Shipping team (Maya) contacted courier; courier requires commercial invoice and Redwood EIN for import paperwork. HR provided contractor's home address; need to confirm whether equipment is Redwood-owned (yes).
- 2026-02-27: Security (Liam) will only hand over physical keys at badge issuance; suggested using building's sealed key envelope process and photo-signed log.
- 2026-02-28: Facilities identified lift restrictions on 2026-03-03; recommended moving kitting to 2026-03-02 morning to avoid maintenance window.
- Hypothesis: Delay is caused by missing HR attachment and incomplete shipping documentation.
- Temporary workaround considered: Issue a visitor badge for 2026-03-04 morning and courier same-day local purchase of spare monitor if cross-border shipment cannot clear in time (cost estimate £520).
resolution: In progress: HR requested to upload contractor agreement and photo by 2026-03-01 (Sofia notified). Shipping team to re-submit commercial invoice with Redwood EIN and explicit "business equipment" declaration; DHL confirmed conditional pickup 2026-03-02 if paperwork complete. Facilities to pre-cut cabinet key and hold in sealed envelope at security; Security to issue temporary badge on-scoped time if HR completes PII upload. Follow-ups: generate return-label and offboarding checklist (INT-13490 placeholder) and tag assets in inventory under Jordan Blake ID JB-452. Final resolution will include confirmation that monitors arrived, badge activated, key signed out, and asset IDs recorded.
